updates.title: Market Update
updates.content: The US stock market continued its upward momentum this week, with the S&P 500 index attempting to break to a new high, despite low volume and a lack of conviction among investors.

updates.title: Current Developments
updates.content: The latest PCE data came in as expected, with headline PCE at 0.0% and core PCE at 0.1%, while personal spending dropped to 0.2%, inline with the consumer pulling back trend.

updates.title: Market Reactions
updates.content: The market reaction was muted, with the S&P 500 index showing a technical setup for a potential breakout, but also significantly above the support zone, indicating a lack of favorable risk-reward ratio for buying.

updates.title: Portfolio Strategy
updates.content: For a diversified long-term investor, it's essential to separate political views from investing and wait for the air to clear post-debate, considering the Magnificent Seven stocks, mega cap stocks, and fossil fuel energy stocks as potential winners.

updates.title: Looking Ahead
updates.content: Next week, investors should watch for changes in the portfolios and potential market reactions to the ongoing presidential debate and its impact on the American economy and US international standing.
